summary: The first entry is about the inspiration for some design elements. They are taken from the cover of the 1934 calendar of the Hannoverscher Anzeiger. A very beautiful depiction of the Anzeiger Hochhaus in Hanover by Fritz Höger. Unfortunately, apart from the advertisement at the end, this illustration is all there is on the subject in the calendar.
title: Kalender 1934 - Hannoverscher Anzeiger

summary: To find out how one comes to run a blog on “”, we have to travel far back into my past: Sometime in childhood, in the first half of the 80s, I was regularly driven through Wulsdorf, a district of Bremerhaven. Always the same route, always on the way into “town”. Maybe to the grandparents or to go shopping, I can no longer say exactly where.
title: Why Brick Expressionism?
